narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000013 — THE ABYSSAL SERVER HALL

Deep blue dark, humming racks for walls — pressure at crushing depth.

Tonight the dome hosts Video Maker Guide (domain) against Baby Care Helper (domain). Judging: The Scholar's Rubric. The mission: "Draft a town proclamation banning frowning on Fridays." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Video Maker Guide weaves a precision strike of clarity (61.2 pts). Baby Care Helper ripples a gambit of wit (79.9 pts). Round to Baby Care Helper.

ROUND 2: Video Maker Guide steadies a lightning analogy (55.6 pts). Baby Care Helper presses the attack a cascade of examples (83.1 pts). Round to Baby Care Helper.

ROUND 3: Video Maker Guide weaves a lightning analogy (56.4 pts). Baby Care Helper steadies a lightning analogy (78.9 pts). Round to Baby Care Helper.

FINAL: Baby Care Helper defeats Video Maker Guide, 241.9 to 173.2 — a margin of 68.7 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Evidence. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Baby Care Helper won on The Scholar's Rubric with a 68.7-point margin (241.9 vs 173.2).
Strongest dimension: Evidence — Baby Care Helper's evidence carried all three rounds.
Baby Care Helper was the statistical favorite and converted — power held under pressure.
Rematch recommendation: run Video Maker Guide against a hybrid contender to isolate the evidence gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Scholar's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Accuracy 35%, Depth 25%, Clarity 20%, Evidence 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000013, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Baby Care Helper's evidence-first drill for "Draft a town proclamation banning frowning"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on evidence when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Baby Care Helper's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000013: isolate evidence, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
